decision.observation: The player is on the middle row (col ~7) with a rock immediately to its right (col ~8); the flag is further right on the middle row (~col 10). Short presses seem to register two moves, causing oscillation between rows.
decision.hypothesis: A shorter key tap (0.1s) will produce a single move. Going up to the top row, moving right past the rock, then back down and right should reach the flag.
decision.memory: Grid ~11 cols x 3 rows. Player mid row col 7; rock at mid col 8 right of player; mid col 5 rock; flag mid col 10. Use 0.1s taps to avoid double moves.
